observation.text: Park properly: engine off, park brake, hazards on. Then get out and look at it.
Check on them first: are they hurt, do they need an ambulance?
"I'm sorry this happened. Are you hurt? Let's exchange information, and I'll report it."
"I can't. Every incident gets reported — that protects you too."
Report it to dispatch now: where, both vehicles, nobody hurt.
Wide shots of both vehicles in place, close-ups of the damage, his plate, the street.
"Yes please — name and a number, if you don't mind."
Write that the car was parked illegally across the driveway and the contact was unavoidable.
